# model/
#
# This directory holds the trained ML model files generated by train_model.py
#
# Files created here after training:
#   voice_detector.pkl  — Trained RandomForest pipeline (scaler + classifier)
#   metrics.json        — Evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1)
#
# To generate these files, run:
#   python train_model.py
#
# This directory is intentionally left empty in the repository.
# The .pkl file is excluded from git (.gitignore) because it can be large.
